title: The Fisherman's Wife | A Surreal AI Dreamscape
description:
👉 I’m building these worlds daily. If they resonate for you, follow for more.
 
I absolutely love this style. It reminds me of an adult fairy tale. Strange and surreal. When I make these, coming up with the music is a bit hard as there is no real theme. So I just make a song that might not fit the narrative but fits the style. That's what I did here. The song story doesn't really fit the video story but you can kind of make it up when you watch I think :-) It's like two stories coming together. My workflow: Images were made using #Midjourney and animated using #VEO3. The song was made using @suno
